== Published English Original Virtual Set 7 wording ==
The remaster counts two qualifying TIEs piloted by Imperials without the old unique restriction. It explicitly prints a range of zero to three parsecs, consistent with the period rule that permits zero-parsec hyperspeed movement under its usual conditions. The deployment, opposing drain and Alter immunity stay the same. Earlier Decipher Flagship Operations and Set 5 Flagship (V) have separate identities.
